title: Chat input
description: The chat composer, in three layouts. Default: the workbench Chat view input (toolbar row under the editor: add context, agent, model, tools; send; secondary toolbar: session target, permissions). variant="session": the Agents window composer in an open session, one row with Add Context, the harness's session controls (Copilot: Mode | Permissions; Claude: Approvals; Codex: Agent Mode + Approvals), the model picker (provider icon, model, effort · context), Dictation/Voice and Send, with the context window usage ring at the top right. variant="new-session": the new-session composer (sessions.chat.experimental.newSessionComposerLayout), the session options strip (environment, workspace, isolation | branch, harness) above the same input with the "Pitch your idea" placeholder. In the Agents layouts every picker opens its real options (ds.chatPickers: harnesses, environments, workspaces, models with effort/context/pricing, modes and permissions, captured from the signed-in product); choices update the composer and fire `change`.
usage: Default layout: inside <vsc-chat-view> (`<vsc-chat-view><vsc-chat-input>`); pass items with slot="toolbar" / slot="secondary" to customize. Agents window: `<vsc-workbench window="agents">` + `<vsc-session-view><vsc-chat-input variant="session">` for an open session, or `<vsc-session-view variant="new"><vsc-chat-input variant="new-session">` for a new one; set harness/model/mode/permissions/environment/workspace to start from a given state. Typing enables send; listen for `change` to react to picker choices.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Layout: empty = workbench Chat view; session = Agents window open session; new-session = Agents window new-session composer

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Defaults: "Describe what to build", "Chat with Copilot" (session, per harness), "Pitch your idea" (new-session)

attributes.name: no-secondary
attributes.description: Hide the default secondary toolbar items (default layout)

attributes.name: harness
attributes.description: Agents layouts: which session controls and models to show

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Agents layouts: selected model id (defaults to the harness's default, e.g. gpt-5-6-sol-fast-internal-only)

attributes.name: approvals
attributes.description: Claude (ask, edit, plan, auto, bypass) or Codex (default, auto-review, full) approval mode

attributes.name: notice
attributes.description: session: show the prompt-cache notice in the model picker

states.name: change (event)
states.description: detail: the changed setting, e.g. { model }, { mode, permissions }, { harness }, { environment }
states.trigger: pick an option in any Agents picker

states.name: responsive
states.description: Pickers collapse from right to left as their row runs out of room (ChatInputPickerResponsiveLayout): the model picker ellipsizes its name, then shows its icon + configuration, then just its icon; mode and session pickers show their icon; labeled pickers never squeeze.

sources.note: Agents window composer (session and new-session layouts)
